entries.title: Winterspring
body: A beautiful snowy valley in northern Kalimdor, north-east of Mount Hyjal, reached from Felwood through Timbermaw Hold. Wild creatures roam it, frostsabers, yetis, owlbeasts and chimaerae, among old night elf ruins. The goblins keep a trading post at its crossroads, and the night elves a village on its road.
Long ago it was home to many blue dragons, among them Haleh, consort of the Aspect Malygos, and their great ice cavern of Mazthoril is still the blue dragonflight's chief home in Kalimdor.

entries.title: Everlook
body: A Steamwheedle Cartel trading post at the crossroads of Winterspring's trade routes, with a goblin laboratory. The Argent Dawn has sent Gregor Greystone to speak for it to the goblins who run the town.

entries.title: Starfall Village
body: A small night elf village on the main road north-west of Everlook, the Alliance's only settlement in Winterspring, with a lodge and the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den behind it.

entries.title: Mazthoril
body: A huge, deep cavern of ice in central Winterspring, home of the blue dragons. Their matriarch, the reclusive Haleh, lives at its peak in the guise of a high elf, reached only by a portal rune in the cavern floor. Four powerful drakes guard the caves, and her brood of sorcerous dragonspawn and young whelps patrols the valley.

entries.title: The Ruins of Kel'Theril
body: The remains of a great night elf city on the shore of a frozen lake. Its Highborne stole the Crystal of Zin-Malor from the temple at Eldarath, toyed with its tempting power, and when it shattered, its curse fell on them all. Kel'Theril suffered until the Sundering destroyed it. Their tormented ghosts still wander the ruins, and one of them, at least, is sorry.

entries.title: Frostsaber Rock
body: A great jutting tor in the north of the valley. At its very top stands Rivern Frostwind, a trainer of wintersabers, who will teach friends of the Alliance to tame and ride the beautiful cats.

entries.title: The Winterfall Furbolgs
body: The Winterfall tribe of corrupted furbolgs holds a great village in the far east near Everlook, ruled by High Chief Winterfall from a cave at its top. They have taken Timbermaw Post too, which, as its name says, once belonged to their uncorrupted kin.

entries.title: Frostfire Hot Springs
body: Steaming pools in the far west of the icy valley. Donova Snowden, camped nearby, wonders how they came to be in such a land and what power they hold; she suspects the demons of Darkwhisper Gorge.

entries.title: Darkwhisper Gorge
body: When Archimonde fell at Mount Hyjal, the remnants of his army fled and took refuge in Darkwhisper Gorge, in the far south, reached across a great bridge over Frostwhisper Gorge. Frostwhisper is scattered with night elf ruins, and roamed by frost giants and ice avatars.

entries.title: Owl Wing Thicket and the Hidden Grove
body: The caves of Owl Wing Thicket in the south are full of berserk, moon-touched owlbeasts. Here the ancient Guardians of Elune tell how the moonkin came into the world, for those the priestess Ranshalla guides. In the north-east the Hidden Grove, a forested crater walled by cliffs with one cave for a door, has become home to hostile moonkin.

entries.title: Dun Mandarr and the Ice Thistle Hills
body: The dwarf Jaron Stoneshaper set up camp at Dun Mandarr in the south-east, until he found a blue-feathered amulet that enraged the local wildkin, and they chased him off and wrecked his camp. The Ice Thistle yetis den in the hills south-east of Everlook.

entries.title: Winterspring in the Third War
body: In the Third War, the Horde, the humans, the Scourge, the Sentinels and corrupted satyrs all made camps in Winterspring. Tyrande and Malfurion destroyed a human camp and the satyrs, and woke the Druids of the Talon from their barrow dens. A death revenant cursed a glade and raised skeletons and ghosts in it; they defeated him and won the glade back.
